subject: Request: pilot continuance due to adapter regression blocking onboarding
messages:
From: Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@greenbyte.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@greenbyte.io>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: onboarding blocker — third-party adapter regression (request for pilot continuance)

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from the integration team at Greenbyte. During the last two integration attempts we hit a regression in the payments adapter provided by one of our vendors — it corrupts session metadata on token refresh which prevents our ingest pipeline from completing. Our engineers are triaging but the fix depends on a vendor patch (estimated 2–3 weeks).

The current pilot window for the Redwood trial expires 2026-05-25 and we won't have meaningful telemetry to evaluate performance or complete the demo until the adapter is stable. Can we request a continuance of the pilot window (or a temporary sandbox extension) so we have time to finish validation once the vendor patch lands?

What would help from your side:
- Short-term extension of the pilot expiry by ~30 days
- One-off sandbox credits so we can re-run full-scale ingest tests after the fix
- A shared place to drop logs (I attached a minimal log bundle)

Thanks,
Tanya Brooks
Director, Integrations
Greenbyte Analytics

Attachment: integration-logs.tar.gz (submitted by Greenbyte)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@greenbyte.io>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@greenbyte.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding blocker — third-party adapter regression (request for pilot continuance)

Tanya — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs. Sorry you hit this during validation. I shared the bundle with engineering and Karthik is triaging vendor interactions now.

Internally I'm going to request a 30-day continuance and a modest credit top-up so you can re-run the ingest once the vendor patch arrives. To make approval faster, could you confirm:
- whether the blocked flows are limited to token refresh (yes/no)
- an estimate for how many ingest runs you'll need after the patch (ballpark)
- whether any PII is present in the attached logs (so we can advise on sharing)

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm commercial approval path and get us a temporary extension while engineering works the vendor.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
On 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00 Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@greenbyte.io> wrote:
> Hi Aditya,
> 
> Quick note from the integration team...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@greenbyte.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding blocker — third-party adapter regression (request for pilot continuance)

Aditya / Tanya — I reviewed the request and the attached logs. Given the vendor dependency and the commercial stage of this deal (DEAL-8421), we can approve the following as a one-time concession:

- Pilot continuance: extend the trial window by 30 calendar days (new expiry 2026-06-24)
- Sandbox credits: provide a 150k-token credit pool for re-validation runs
- SOW draft: I'm attaching a short SOW addendum that documents the extension; please sign to acknowledge (SOW-draft-Greenbyte.pdf).

Two asks from our side to close this quickly:
1) Please confirm that the logs contain no PII or that Greenbyte will sanitize before we store them.
2) If the vendor patch timeline slips beyond three weeks, flag us — we'll evaluate a second credit tranche on a case-by-case basis.

Aditya — Karthik, please coordinate with Greenbyte on the temporary staging environment and confirm we've whitelisted their IPs for smoke tests. Tanya — I'll send the DocuSign link after Aditya confirms the PII status.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-draft-Greenbyte.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@greenbyte.io>
Date: 2026-05-21T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding blocker — third-party adapter regression (request for pilot continuance)

Thanks — quick update from engineering: the failure is isolated to the vendor's token-refresh library (we reproduced with their latest patch candidate). Vendor has queued a fix for 2026-05-28 and we expect a low-risk rollout.

Tanya — logs are fine from a PII perspective; we confirmed with your team that all identifiers are test keys. Greenbyte can go ahead and upload the sanitized bundle to the Jira ticket (INT-743) and we'll provision the extended sandbox and credits once the DocuSign is signed.

Aditya / Marissa — please update HubSpot (DEAL-8421) with the extension and note the new expiry date. I'll standby for the smoke-test IP whitelist (Connor is on the networking side if needed).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineer, Redwood Inference
